us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico to sue Trump administration over White House access ban
bullets: The three outlets said they notified the administration they are filing a lawsuit.
Their reporters were blocked from the White House after Trump accused them of “fake news.”
The White House Correspondents’ Association called for the outlets’ access to be restored.

articles.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man during Austin traffic stop
bullets: Austin officials said the man was shot once in the torso and was in serious but stable condition.
The Department of Homeland Security said he was in federal custody pending removal.
Austin’s mayor said city police should have a role in the investigation.

articles.title: Kamala Harris steps into 2026 midterms as 2028 decision looms
bullets: Harris is campaigning for Democrats, starting with Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed.
Additional rallies are planned in Nevada and Georgia.
Her midterm role comes as she weighs whether to run for president again in 2028.

articles.title: Republicans lean on ‘no tax on tips’ pitch in Nevada House race
bullets: Nevada’s 3rd District is a competitive race between Rep. Susie Lee and Republican Marty O’Donnell.
The district includes many hospitality workers who rely on tips.
Republicans are highlighting Trump’s tipped-income tax policy in the midterm campaign.

articles.title: Trump attacks Democrats as ‘communists’ while preparing Xi state visit
bullets: Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington this week.
AP reported the visit comes as Trump intensifies anti-communist attacks on Democrats.
The administration’s growing stakes in private companies have drawn criticism from some Republicans.

articles.title: Russian drones hit Zaporizhzhia after Ukraine’s 1,000-drone weekend barrage
bullets: Russian drones struck Zaporizhzhia, hitting apartment blocks, a university and a shopping mall.
Ukrainian officials said five people were wounded in the attack.
The strikes came as leaders gathered for the U.N. General Assembly.

articles.title: Projectile strikes tanker entering Strait of Hormuz
bullets: The British military said an unknown projectile hit a tanker entering the Strait of Hormuz.
Two crew members suffered minor injuries, and the vessel continued under its own power.
AP reported tanker traffic remains well below normal through the key oil route.

articles.title: Wars, AI fears and climate shocks dominate U.N. General Assembly week
bullets: World leaders are meeting at the U.N. amid wars in Iran, Gaza, Ukraine, Sudan, Congo and Myanmar.
Runaway AI risks and climate shocks are also major agenda items.
U.N. reform is expected to be discussed as the organization marks its 81st year.

articles.title: Police officer and man wounded near Ontario synagogue on Yom Kippur
bullets: A police officer and a man were wounded in gunfire near Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville, Ontario.
The man was hospitalized in life-threatening condition.
Authorities said they had not determined whether the synagogue or Jewish community was targeted.

articles.title: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham set for first Trump meeting at U.N.
bullets: Burnham and Trump are expected to meet on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York.
Ukraine air defenses and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz are on the agenda.
Burnham is scheduled to address world leaders on Tuesday.

articles.title: UP teacher shot dead in front of students; attacker dies by suicide
bullets: Police said a woman teacher was killed inside a Lakhimpur Kheri school on Monday.
The accused then shot himself, according to officials.
Investigators are questioning witnesses, school staff and family members to determine the motive.

articles.title: IIT Bombay student’s family demands CBI probe after hostel death
bullets: Sahil Wakode’s grandmother told NDTV the family wants a CBI inquiry.
The 22-year-old student was found dead in his hostel room.
The family has alleged caste discrimination and institutional harassment.

articles.title: Ram Temple donation theft caught on CCTV 105 times, court told
bullets: The Supreme Court was informed of 105 recorded instances of donation theft at Ayodhya’s Ram Mandir.
Eight accused are in custody, according to NDTV’s report.
The SIT is expected to file its charge sheet by September 25.

articles.title: IMD warns of heavy rain in eastern and southern India
bullets: Heavy to extremely heavy rain is forecast in parts of eastern and southern India from September 22–27.
Odisha is under red alert for intense rain and squally winds from September 23–24.
Delhi-NCR is expected to remain largely dry on Tuesday.

articles.title: Assam gives ISRO 70 acres for advanced radar research facility
bullets: Assam provided nearly 70 acres of land free of cost to ISRO.
The ISTRAC Advanced Radar Research Facility foundation stone was laid at Chandrapur near Guwahati.
The facility will track space activity and share data with government and scientific bodies.

articles.title: Intel jumps in premarket as AI-linked chip stocks rebound
bullets: Intel rose about 5% in Monday premarket trading.
The move came as Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures advanced.
Benzinga said traders were rotating back into technology and semiconductor names.

articles.title: Marvell rises as tech risk appetite improves
bullets: Marvell shares gained about 3% in Monday premarket trading.
The stock benefited from a broader rebound in growth and AI-related names.
Marvell also said it would showcase 2-nanometer optical interconnect technology for AI data centers.

articles.title: Accenture gains after Anthropic AI safety partnership
bullets: Accenture rose about 6% in premarket trading.
The company and Anthropic each pledged at least $1 billion over five years for AI model evaluation work.
Accenture’s Faculty unit will lead an embedded evaluation team working with Anthropic.

articles.title: Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount rise on merger-settlement report
bullets: Warner Bros. Discovery rose 7.9% and Paramount gained 6.8% in premarket trading.
Reuters cited a report that California settlement talks could clear a hurdle to their merger.
The discussions reportedly include California production commitments and CNN editorial-independence measures.

articles.title: Meta climbs after Wells Fargo raises price target on AI momentum
bullets: Meta shares rose 2.4% in premarket trading, according to Reuters reporting carried by Boursorama.
Wells Fargo raised its price target to $796 from $640.
The brokerage cited early traction for Meta’s Muse AI assistant ahead of Meta Connect.

articles.title: SoftBank launches more than $10 billion in bonds to fund OpenAI investment
bullets: SoftBank launched $10 billion and €1 billion of senior unsecured notes.
Proceeds will fund a $10 billion payment for its next OpenAI investment tranche.
The bond sale is expected to price on September 24 and settle on September 29.

articles.title: Paramount discusses California concessions to clear Warner Bros. merger hurdle
bullets: Paramount and California’s attorney general are reportedly in advanced settlement talks.
Concessions under discussion include a $1.5 billion California production investment.
The talks relate to one of the remaining hurdles to Paramount’s Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

articles.title: Volkswagen and Porsche shares fall after profit warning
bullets: Volkswagen shares fell Monday after the automaker cut its 2026 profit-margin outlook.
The warning included a €6 billion goodwill impairment at Porsche.
Porsche and Porsche SE shares also extended declines.

articles.title: Accenture and Anthropic commit $2 billion to AI model evaluation
bullets: The companies announced a partnership focused on red-teaming and alignment testing.
Each company pledged at least $1 billion over five years.
The work will create a dedicated embedded evaluation team for Anthropic models.

articles.title: FCC approves Paramount request tied to Gulf funds in Warner Bros. buyout
bullets: The FCC granted Paramount’s indirect-ownership request connected to Gulf funds in its Warner Bros. Discovery buyout.
Paramount said the funds would not have governance rights.
Critics warned the financing could still create concerns around influence over news operations.

articles.title: U.S. proposes AI incident alert mechanism with China
bullets: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. proposed a notification system for AI incidents affecting national security.
The proposal came during talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York.
The discussions preceded expected Trump-Xi talks in Washington.

articles.title: U.S. and China compete for AI dominance while discussing safety risks
bullets: AP reported the two countries are racing for AI leadership while weighing shared safety concerns.
Bessent said the countries discussed a mechanism for AI dialogue.
The expected Trump-Xi meeting comes amid fears about rogue AI and national-security impacts.

articles.title: AI leaders and governments split over ‘AI doom’ fears
bullets: Reuters reported deep divisions among AI leaders over whether frontier development should slow.
Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have called for coordinated caution.
Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg and Nvidia’s Jensen Huang have been more skeptical of new constraints.

articles.title: GitHub to deprecate six Copilot models on October 19
bullets: GitHub said six Copilot models will be deprecated across Copilot experiences on October 19, 2026.
Affected models include GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.7 Flash and Grok 4.5.
GitHub listed newer suggested alternatives and advised teams to update workflows.

articles.title: Apple reportedly makes second round of job cuts in two months
bullets: Apple reportedly cut a handful of Fitness+ jobs last week.
India Today said affected staff worked on audio features such as Time to Walk and Time to Run.
The report follows a larger round of Apple job cuts last month.
